packages.title: Domain model + tower engine
packages.summary: Pure typed state and tick engine (SPEC §4.1–4.2): initial state, advanceWork, decisionsNeeded, applyActions, startAssigned, agentsOf, zoneOf, holdKeyOf, visibleEdges, unfinishedDeps. No Jev calls, no I/O. Paths are relative to apps/jev-agent-atc/.

packages.title: Jev policy layer + simulated resolvers + route
packages.summary: SPEC §4.3 and §5: System One questions (choice/noul/score), toJevState/buildRequest, POLICY thresholds + interpret + fallbackActions, scripted atcResolvers/createAtcProvider, decideNeed, and the live-swap route. Imports only types from src/domain (never engine).

packages.title: Control-tower UI
packages.summary: SPEC §4.5 and §6: selectors, layout, TowerCanvas (gates, aircraft cards, routing edges with probability badges, dependency lanes, holding pattern, retry loop, runway, human pad), DecisionSpotlight/SharedStatePanel, ControlTower wiring useScenarioPlayer + ScenarioControls + DecisionLogPanel, tower.css. Built against the domain types and fixture runs; owns the visual e2e checks.

packages.title: Scenario runner + page integration
packages.summary: SPEC §4.4, §4.6 and §7: SCENARIO config, captions, runScenario (virtual clock + createJev + engine loop), parsePlayerParams, and app/page.tsx rendering DemoShell + ControlTower. Verifies the 30 s story end to end.
